title: Eisenhorn: The Omnibus
author: Dan Abnett
note: conf=0.95; ISBN 9781800269187 matches the Black Library ebook edition (29 Oct 2022) of "Eisenhorn: The Omnibus" by Dan Abnett, catalogued by OverDrive under the series "Warhammer 40,000: Eisenhorn". It is an omnibus collecting the novels Xenos, Malleus, Hereticus and The Magos plus the short stories Regia Occulta, Missing in Action, Backcloth for a Crown Additional and The Keeler Image — hence it belongs to the Eisenhorn series but has no single numbered position (it spans vols. 1-4). Tight sub-series "Eisenhorn" chosen over the broader Warhammer 40,000 / Inquisition universe.
